centrelineMethod: measured twice: the kit's median-of-thick-vertices pass to find the limb clusters, then the mid-range of the 4th and 96th percentiles over every vertex that is not thin and not nearer a limb polyline than the rough axis

limbBinding.method: Voronoi split against the body's own axial polyline

limbSweepMethod: the largest angle between any two directions the limb points over the cycle, taken from the root joint to the tip joint in world space

shoreClipTiming.source: TELEGRAPH, the strike window and RECOVER in src/sim/triassic/shore.ts

mouth.method: painted line, read as a continuous curve under a raised jump penalty (the geometric method found no slit)
